name: incantly-canvas-monorepo
description: Incantly Canvas — the MIT-licensed infinite-canvas whiteboard SDK. Monorepo root.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@incantly/canvas-core && npm run build --workspace=@incantly/canvas-react && npm run build --workspace=@incantly/canvas-react-native
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run typecheck --workspace=@incantly/canvas-core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@incantly/canvas-react && npm run typecheck --workspace=@incantly/canvas-react-native
scripts.publish:all: npm publish --workspace=@incantly/canvas-core --access public && npm publish --workspace=@incantly/canvas-react --access public && npm publish --workspace=@incantly/canvas-react-native --access public
